Pages = 2n must be ≡ 3 (mod 7), so 2n = 7k + 3 with 2n even. That requires k odd. Then n = (7k+3)/2 > 100 gives 7k + 3 > 200, so k > 28.14, and k ≥ 29. Since 29 is odd, 2n = 206 and n = 103.

Check: 206 = 7·29 + 3 = 203 + 3, which is correct. Smaller candidates fail: n = 102 gives 204 ≡ 1 (mod 7), n = 101 gives 202 ≡ 6, and n = 103 gives 206 ≡ 3. So 103 is the smallest.

Solution A ignores the condition n > 100 and answers 19, so it is wrong. Solution B gives 103, which is correct.

WINNER: B
